Yvonne: Quick q  my partner's parent arrives Dec 24-26. I started in July and have limited accrual. Is there a way to get approved time off in the Dec 20-27 blackout?

Leo (Manager): We can try to approve if coverage is arranged. Are you on any rotations or critical releases those days?

Yvonne: No releases. I'm on the docs rotation but can hand off. I have ~6h left in current accrual and 10h carryover. Need two full days.

HR Bot: Reminder: Dec 20-27 is a company blackout. Exceptions require manager attestation + People Ops sign-off. External carryover isn't transferable.

Sam (People Ops): You can request a "Blackout Exception" in TimeOff app. Options: use accrual + carryover, or unpaid for any shortfall. Attach a coverage note and manager attestation. We typically respond within 48h.

Yvonne: Filed Request ID 20440088. Coverage note: docs rota handed to Maya; no oncall. Leo attested in form.

Leo (Manager): Attestation: "I confirm coverage arranged and approve Yvonne's dates."

Zoe (Payroll): If unpaid portion is selected, please flag as "Unpaid Exception" so payroll handles deductions correctly. Carryover consumption will be reflected in year-end reports.

Sam (People Ops): Reviewing now. Quick check: how many total hours requested vs balances?

Yvonne: Request is 16h total; balances cover 16h (6 current + 10 carryover). No unpaid required.

Sam (People Ops): Great. Approved: "Blackout Exception Approved: accrual+carryover used, coverage verified." Policy ref PTO-3.2 and PTO-4.1. Audit note EX-2026-25.

HR Bot: Request 20440088 status: APPROVED by Sam (People Ops).

Yvonne: Thanks all! I'll update calendar and leave handover notes.
